selected_scope.title: Universal Interior Viability / Equal Availability
selected_scope.finding: Cumulative exact S1.42AK-BMAFR1 evidence now establishes a bounded Black Mesa x Abandoned Foundry / FoundryFlow runtime-compatibility PASS. First evidence RuntimeEvidence/S1.42AK-BMAFR1/20261002T154834Z/ / raw log SHA-256 3113a1c9df2e1db231cf6aa0e7dc20699894a8646da3eaf7fd1ce0c3d89ac42b proved ARMED, exact normalized-100 singleton selection, completed generation, TOPOLOGY_OK ids=0,1,2,3 and bidirectional direct traversal for IDs 0,1,3. Supplemental evidence RuntimeEvidence/S1.42AK-BMAFR1/20261002T164741Z/ / raw log SHA-256 ca2d83a56115f66623c3dfb38d2cdd47085b3c0a368efc3ace29321a323b4d90 re-established the target and directly traversed missing ID 2 / outside EntranceTeleportC in both directions; final supplemental coverage is bidirectional for IDs 0..3 with no BMAFDIAG1 refusal/inconclusive invalidator and no post-generation persistent target-attributable routing/NavMesh failure. User observation confirms all three fire exits were exercised in/out; the only reported abnormality was generally less-fluid frame rate. The supplemental log contains 6696 'Array index (0) is out of bounds (size=0)' errors, absent from the first exact same-pair run, with a close but non-causal Janitor-lifetime temporal correlation. Preserve that as a separate performance-attribution finding; do not misattribute it to the pair or dismiss it as monitor-only. BMAFR1 remains DIAGNOSTIC ONLY / NEVER ACCEPT. The reviewed bounded performance-attribution checkpoint at SourceEvidence/BMAFR1Performance/20261002T173617Z/ proves a sustained 6696-message stackless Unity Log flood at about 45/s in the supplemental run, while the first exact same-pair run has zero. BCMER is proven as the relevant spawn-message owner and DawnLib.Dusk as the nearby TransferRenderer-warning / separate SkinnedMeshReplacement-NRE owner; neither is proven as the array emitter. Janitor and SpringMan spawn nearly together, and the flood ends during shared lobby/network shutdown before their near-simultaneous cleanup, so Janitor-death causation is not established. Janitor index-0 blendshape writes plus Dusk sharedMesh replacement form a concrete mesh/animation compatibility hypothesis, but exact replacement assets, target hierarchy, live/original/replacement blendshape counts and animation bindings remain unresolved. Static attribution is therefore not exhausted.
selected_scope.analysis_contract: Treat Black Mesa x Abandoned Foundry as passed for the bounded BMAFR1 generation/topology/entrance/traversal compatibility contract. Treat SourceEvidence/BMAFR1Performance/20261002T173617Z/ as a reviewed partial performance-attribution checkpoint only: 6696 stackless array-index errors are proven in the supplemental run; BCMER spawn ownership and DawnLib.Dusk warning/separate-NRE ownership are proven; the array emitter/root cause remains unproven. Do not infer Janitor causation from cleanup timing because lobby/network shutdown and near-simultaneous SpringMan cleanup confound the endpoint. Continue only with bounded static asset-level Janitor + SpringMan replacement/hierarchy/mesh blendshape/animation-binding resolution before considering instrumentation, patching, builds, or runtime tests. Preserve accepted S1.42AK, accepted S1.42AB normalization, BMAFR1 DIAGNOSTIC ONLY / NEVER ACCEPT and no qualification rerun, BMAFDIAG1/PATH1 DO NOT RERUN, and separate active/not-accepted S1.42AK-BMDSFIX1 with its passive/unwaived DeepSewersFlow gate and no dedicated reroll.
selected_scope.next_action: After the reviewed BMAFR1 performance-attribution checkpoint is integrated to main and permanent exact-head Knowledge Architecture is green, perform one bounded repository-native static asset-level attribution of the supplemental-run `Array index (0) is out of bounds (size=0)` flood. Resolve the exact Janitor and contemporaneous SpringMan replacement definitions/actions and eligible/selected asset paths as far as repository/package evidence permits; identify target hierarchies, original/replacement skinned meshes, blendShapeCount values, bone mappings, and relevant Animator/AnimationClip blendshape bindings. Test whether a concrete index-0/zero-blendshape or animation-binding incompatibility is statically established, while keeping the array emitter/root cause unresolved unless it is actually linked to the observed instance/signature. Do not derive a patch, new build, or runtime test from the current checkpoint. Preserve the Black Mesa x Abandoned Foundry BMAFR1 pair PASS and do not rerun it for qualification; preserve S1.42AK as accepted and S1.42AK-BMDSFIX1 as active/not accepted with its passive, outstanding, unwaived DeepSewersFlow gate and no dedicated reroll. After the asset-level reconciliation, reassess whether attribution can close unresolved from static evidence or whether narrowly scoped instrumented runtime evidence is justified; otherwise continue the remaining Phase C3 compatibility/safety work under the universal-interior plan.
currently_irrelevant_actions: Do not globally force all dungeon flows onto all moons before pair-specific compatibility/safety evidence supports the exact pairing being changed.
Do not modify or replace the accepted S1.42AB InteriorWeightNormalization behavior; it already provides equal effective rarity 100 after viability filtering.
Do not duplicate-register Black Mesa or other DawnLib/JLL/native-owned content through LLL merely to force availability.
Do not remove the Shatteredrooms Experimentation/Embrion restriction until its technical compatibility reason is resolved and tested.

Do not fold CullFactory junkrooms/shatteredrooms exceptions, MelanieMausoleum fog tuning, Black Mesa/Pikmin route recovery, LethalEscapeUpdated, AdditionalNetworking or broad LethalMin repair into this scope.

phase_c.phase_c3_priority: External target moons Black Mesa and Oxyde
phase_c.black_mesa_deep_sewers_incident: Normal fallback selected Deep Sewers after BMGHDIAG2 refused. LLL reported 3.25->4.875 / final 4.87 and DunGenPlus emitted repeated placement failures without a later generation-complete marker in the captured post-selection evidence.
phase_c.black_mesa_substation_runtime_finding: Black Mesa selected Substation. LLL reported DungeonSize 6.343513->9.515268 and ButteRyBalance final 9.51; generation completed, but hangar OPEN occurred while landed=False before Players finished generating the new floor, and Ship has landed was logged later. The user reported severe stutter/freezing and an apparent second landing. Preserve as a separate non-target runtime/performance finding; the evidence does not attribute it to BMDSFIX1 because no BMDSFIX1 APPLIED marker occurred.
phase_c.black_mesa_expanded_facility_runtime_fin: Regular exact-byte BMDSFIX1 armed. Black Mesa returned 31 viable interiors normalized to effective rarity 100 including Deep Sewers(100), but naturally selected Expanded facility. Dungeon generation and Players finished generating the new floor completed. The user reported normal landing, acceptable Entering-the-atmosphere duration, normal movement, and no noticeable entrance/exit issue. This is an additional non-target control only and does not satisfy the natural DeepSewersFlow target gate.
phase_c.black_mesa_slaughterhouse_runtime_findin: The regular BMDSFIX1 evidence contains two consecutive Black Mesa selections from the 31-flow normalized viable pool: seed 71489917 selected Slaughterhouse and seed 14991801 selected Slaughterhouse. Both runs reached Players finished generating the new floor. These are additional non-target observations only; no additional user gameplay claim is attached and the natural DeepSewersFlow target gate remains outstanding.
phase_c.black_mesa_deep_sewers_supporting_findin: DIAG1PATH1 deterministically selected Black Mesa / DeepSewersFlow from a normalized 31-entry viable pool; BMDSFIX1 applied 4.875->1; final length multiplier was 1; dungeon generation and player floor generation completed; post-generation gameplay continued and the session returned to orbit. The user reported no Entering-the-atmosphere problem and no noticeable issue. This supports the mitigation mechanism but does not replace exact BMDSFIX1 gameplay qualification because the diagnostic selector DLL was present.
phase_c.black_mesa_greenhouse_runtime_finding: Exact BMGHDIAG3 diagnostic armed and selected Greenhouse at normalized rarity 100 from Black Mesa's 31-flow viable pool, generation completed, topology resolved IDs 0..3, and run 2 recorded bidirectional direct traversal for all four IDs. User observation confirms the exercised entrance geometry was accessible without severe clipping or persistent routing/NavMesh failure. RuntimeNavMeshBuilder Error-severity source-mesh messages are retained as a non-blocking observation for this gate.
phase_c.external_owner_rule_applicability_next_a: Use the completed owner-rule applicability closure only as selection-layer input to pair-specific compatibility/safety proof. Before authoring a universal availability candidate or enabling a previously absent pairing, identify that exact pairing/restriction and satisfy the investigation plan's generation, entrance/topology, traversal, routing/NavMesh and duplicate-registration safety obligations. Preserve the historical B3 matrix, explicit Oxyde ordinary-generation exception, Shatteredrooms exclusions and passive BMDSFIX1 target gate. No runtime/build or universal availability override is authorized by the owner-rule closure itself.
phase_c.bmafdiag1path1_runtime_finding: BMAFDIAG1 armed, then LLL reported Abandoned Foundry unviable on Black Mesa and the diagnostic emitted REFUSED because Foundry was absent from the viable pool. Normal fallback subsequently generated Slaughterhouse, Drains, Substation and Expanded Mineshaft. The published Foundry config uses a plain [Custom Dungeon:  Abandoned Foundry] category, while exact LLL 1.7.12 binds Custom Dungeon categories with nine leading U+200B sorting characters; the generic builder created the wrong category and the BMAFDIAG1 validator normalized Unicode Cf characters away, masking the mismatch.
phase_c.bmafr1_next_action: After this BMAFR1 runtime-compatibility reconciliation is integrated to main and permanent exact-head Knowledge Architecture is green, perform one bounded repository-native performance-attribution triage of the supplemental-run `Array index (0) is out of bounds (size=0)` flood. Compare the first and supplemental exact BMAFR1 evidence, identify the emitting call path/owner as far as repository/source evidence permits, and test the observed Janitor-lifetime temporal correlation against alternative explanations before proposing any patch or new runtime build. Do not rerun BMAFR1 solely for pair qualification and do not release a dedicated BMDSFIX1 reroll; its regular Black Mesa x DeepSewersFlow gate remains passive/outstanding/unwaived. After the bounded performance triage, continue the remaining Phase C3 compatibility/safety work under the existing universal-interior plan.
phase_c.bmafr1_partial_runtime_finding: First exact BMAFR1 run passed diagnostic arming, exact Abandoned Foundry selection, completed generation and four-pair topology. IDs 0, 1 and 3 were directly traversed in both directions; ID 2 was not traversed in that first evidence.
phase_c.bmafr1_runtime_finding: Supplemental exact BMAFR1 evidence directly traverses ID 2 / outside EntranceTeleportC in both directions and reaches final bidirectional coverage for IDs 0..3, with no diagnostic invalidator or post-generation persistent target-attributable routing/NavMesh failure. User exercised all three fire exits in/out. Separate performance finding: 6696 array-index errors plus less-fluid frame rate; absent in the first exact same-pair run and temporally correlated with Janitor lifetime, but root cause/owner not established.
phase_c.bmafr1_performance_attribution_finding: Reviewed checkpoint proves 6696 sustained stackless array-index messages in the supplemental run versus zero in the first exact same-pair run. BCMER owns the spawn path; DawnLib.Dusk owns the adjacent TransferRenderer warning and a separate SkinnedMeshReplacement NRE. Janitor and SpringMan onset/cleanup timing is correlated but not causally isolated because shutdown/disconnect brackets the end. Janitor index-0 blendshape writes plus Dusk sharedMesh replacement is a concrete hypothesis, not a root-cause PASS. Exact replacement assets, target hierarchy, blendshape counts and animation bindings for Janitor and SpringMan remain the next static attribution layer.
